name: Prophets False
overview: Scripture warns believers to discern true prophets from false ones, emphasizing that even if a prophet or dreamer performs signs or wonders, their message must align with devotion to the one true God and not lead to the worship of other gods (Deuteronomy 13:1-3). The Lord tests the heart to reveal genuine love for Him. Furthermore, the validity of a prophet's word is confirmed by the fulfillment of their prophecies; if their predictions do not come to pass, they have spoken presumptuously and should not be feared (Deuteronomy 18:21-22). Additionally, the presence of deceptive spirits influencing false prophets is acknowledged, as seen in the account of a spirit volunteering to persuade a prophet to speak falsely (1 Kings 22:21).
